items.source: MongoDB core support.
items.translation: MongoDB 核心支持。

items.source: Support for MongoDB map-reduce operations.
items.translation: 支持 MongoDB 的 MapReduce 操作。

items.source: With this option, no collection will be created, and the whole map-reduce operation will happen in RAM.
items.translation: 选择此选项时，不会创建任何集合，整个 MapReduce 操作将在内存中完成。

items.source: This option will merge new data into the old output collection.
items.translation: 此选项将把新数据合并到旧输出集合中。

items.source:
If documents exists for a given key in the result set and in the old collection, then a reduce operation (using the
specified reduce function) will be performed on the two values and the result will be written to the output
collection.
items.translation: 如果结果集和旧集合中均存在给定键对应的文档，则会对这两个值执行归约操作（使用指定的归约函数），并将结果写入输出集合。

items.source:
The output will be inserted into a collection which will atomically replace any existing collection with the same
name.
items.translation: 该输出将插入到集合中，并原子性地替换任何具有相同名称的现有集合。

items.source: Define the Collation specifying language-specific rules for string comparison.
items.translation: 定义排序规则，指定用于字符串比较的语言特定规则。

items.source: Sets the finalize function
items.translation: 设置最终化函数

items.source:
Flag that toggles behavior in the map-reduce operation so as to avoid intermediate conversion to BSON between the
map and reduce steps.
items.translation: 用于在 MapReduce 操作中切换行为的标志，以避免在 Map 和 Reduce 步骤之间进行中间 BSON 转换。

items.source:
Limit the number of objects to return from the collection that is fed into the map reduce operation Often used in
conjunction with a query and sort option so as to reduce the portion of the data that will be processed.
items.translation: 限制从输入到 MapReduce 操作的集合中返回的对象数量。通常与查询和排序选项结合使用，以减少需要处理的数据量。

items.source: Static factory method to create a MapReduceOptions instance
items.translation: 用于创建 MapReduceOptions 实例的静态工厂方法。

items.source: The collection where the results from the map-reduce operation will be stored.
items.translation: 存储 MapReduce 操作结果的集合。

items.source: The database where the results from the map-reduce operation will be stored.
items.translation: 存储 MapReduce 操作结果的数据库。

items.source:
Key-value pairs that are placed into JavaScript global scope and can be accessed from map, reduce, and finalize
scripts.
items.translation: 可放入 JavaScript 全局作用域，并可在 map、reduce 和 finalize 脚本中访问的键值对。

items.source: Flag to set that will provide statistics on job execution time.
items.translation: 设置此标志可获取作业执行时间的统计信息。

items.source: Uses of MapReduceOptions in org.springframework.data.mongodb.core
items.translation: MapReduceOptions 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core 中的用途

items.translation: MapReduceOptions 在 org.springframework.data.mongodb.core.mapreduce 包中的用途
